description: Drop messages from the input array until the total is under maxTokens. Three strategies: drop-oldest (default), drop-middle, priority (uses each message's `priority` field). Always returns a structured result with token counts before and after; never throws across the wire.

maxTokens.description: Token budget the result must come in under.

model.description: Optional model name for estimator selection.

preserveFirstN.description: Never drop the first N messages of the input array. Default 0.

preserveLastN.description: Never drop the last N messages of the input array. Default 0.

preserveSystem.description: Default true: never drop messages with role === "system".

name: fit_messages
